faq.q: Why does a polar bear look white if its fur is clear?
faq.a: Each guard hair is transparent and hollow inside. The hairs scatter and reflect all colours of sunlight, and mixed light looks white, the same reason snow and salt look white.
asks: Is polar bear fur really white?

faq.q: Why is polar bear skin black?
faq.a: The skin under the fur is black. Dark skin can soak up some warmth, but scientists have found that very little sunlight gets through the thick fur, so its main protection from cold is the fur and fat.
asks: What colour is a polar bear under its fur?
Do polar bear hairs carry light to the skin?

faq.q: How thick is a polar bear's blubber?
faq.a: A polar bear's fat layer can be up to about 10 centimetres thick. It keeps the bear warm while swimming in freezing water and is an energy store for when seals are hard to catch.
asks: How do polar bears stay warm in the water?

faq.q: Why do polar bears have such big paws?
faq.a: Paws up to 30 centimetres wide spread the bear's weight like snowshoes, so it can cross thin ice. Small bumps and tufts of fur on the pads grip the ice, and the front paws work like paddles when it swims.
asks: How do polar bears walk on ice without slipping?
Why are polar bear feet furry?

faq.q: Do polar bears ever get too hot?
faq.a: Yes. They are so well insulated that running quickly makes them overheat, so polar bears usually walk slowly and rest a lot. On warm days they may lie flat on the ice to cool down.
asks: Why do polar bears walk so slowly?

facts: Polar bear guard hairs are transparent and hollow; they look white because they scatter visible light.
Under its fur a polar bear has black skin.
A polar bear's blubber can be up to about 10 centimetres thick.

quiz.say: What colour is a polar bear's skin under its fur?
quiz.why: The skin is black; the clear guard hairs above it look white because they scatter light.

wrong.1: It is the fur that looks white, not the skin.
wrong.2: Pink skin is found in some other animals, but not polar bears.

quiz.say: A polar bear swims in freezing seawater. What keeps it warm most?
quiz.show: In icy water, what keeps it warm most?
quiz.why: Wet fur traps less air, so the thick layer of fat does most of the insulating in water.

wrong.1: Black skin does little in dark, cold water.
wrong.2: Claws help grip ice and catch seals, not stay warm.
